home.title: The chair is yours. So is the calendar.
home.lead: Your own booking page, a live walk-in queue and reminders that fill the gaps – with no commission per booking.

page.title: Your own booking page
page.body: Customers pick a service, a barber and a time from their phone. The link fits right in your Instagram bio.

queue.title: Live walk-in queue
queue.body: Guests see their place and wait time. You reorder, assign and start with one tap.

rebook.title: Reminders that rebook
rebook.body: When the next cut is due, the customer gets a link to the same service with the same barber.

notFound.title: This chair is empty.
notFound.body: The page you are looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

login.title: Sign in
login.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.lead: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If we have an account for that email, a link is on its way. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Choose a password
reset.done: Your password is saved. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidLink: This link is incomplete. Request a new one.

validation.passwordLength: The password must be at least 10 characters.
validation.outOfRange: The value is out of range.
validation.price: Enter a price in kronor, for example 349 or 349.50.
validation.slug: Only lowercase letters a–z, numbers and hyphens.
validation.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

dashboard.noShop: You're not connected to an active shop. Contact the shop owner.
dashboard.adminNoShop: You're a platform admin and not connected to any shop.

today.title: Today's schedule
today.body: Today's bookings and the walk-in queue will show up here.

upload.wrongType: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
upload.tooLarge: The image can be at most {max} MB.
upload.help: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB. Images are resized automatically.

schedule.invalidRange: The end time must be after the start time.

settings.title: Your shop
settings.slugHint: Customers book at /s/{slug}. Old links stop working if you change it.
settings.bookingRulesHelp: Minimum notice is how late a customer can still book. Cancellation is in hours before the visit.
settings.walkInsHelp: Show a live queue for guests without a booking.
settings.hoursHelp: Set when the shop is open. A day can have several ranges, for example closed for lunch. Days without times are closed.

services.title: Services
services.emptyBody: Add what the shop offers, with duration and price.
services.rebookHint: Leave empty to send no reminders.
services.activeHint: Inactive services are hidden from customers.
services.deleteBody: The service disappears from the menu. Past bookings are not affected.

team.title: Barbers
team.addHint: You can invite the barber to sign in afterwards.
team.emptyBody: Add the people who cut hair in the shop.
team.noLoginHint: This barber has no login. Invite them to see their schedule and manage their profile.
team.deleteBody: The barber can no longer be booked or sign in. Past bookings are kept.

services.help: Tick the services this barber offers. Leave price and duration empty to use the service default.
services.readonlyHelp: The services this barber offers. The owner changes them.
services.invalid: Check prices and durations. Durations use steps of 5 minutes.

schedule.workingHoursHelp: When the barber works in a normal week. Only time within opening hours can be booked.
schedule.breaksHelp: Recurring breaks, such as lunch. They are blocked for booking.
schedule.outsideOpening: Partly outside the shop's opening hours. That part can't be booked.
schedule.breakOutsideHours: The break is outside working hours.

portfolio.help: Up to 30 images. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each.
portfolio.caption: Caption for image {n}

admin.title: Shops
admin.deactivateBody: The booking page and staff access stop working. Nothing is deleted.
admin.slugHint: Leave empty to create one from the name.
admin.inviteHint: A new owner gets an email to choose a password.

barber.title: Who would you like?
barber.anyHint: Shows the earliest times across all barbers.
barber.none: No barber offers this service right now.

time.title: Pick a time
time.noneInWindow: No free times on these days. Try later days.

details.title: Your details
details.name: Name
details.phoneHint: We text you a code to confirm the number.
details.cancellation: You can cancel or move the booking until {hours} hours before.

otp.sendFirst: Send and enter the code from the SMS first.

manage.bookedBody: Keep the link below; you can move or cancel the booking there.
manage.linkBody: This page is yours. Anyone with the link can change the booking, so keep it to yourself.
manage.cancelBody: The time becomes free for someone else.
manage.deadline: You can change or cancel until {when}.
manage.tooLate: It's too late to change online. Call the shop: {phone}

myBookings.title: My bookings
myBookings.signIn: Sign in with your phone number
myBookings.signInBody: We text you a code. No password needed.
